detections.mission_name: Inventory SKU Turn Rate & Top Movers
detections.sql:
SELECT p.sku, p.style_name, SUM(se.units_sold) AS total_units_sold 
FROM sales_events se 
JOIN products p ON se.sku = p.sku 
GROUP BY p.sku, p.style_name 
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC;
detections.insight: Our analysis reveals that the top-selling products in the operations domain are primarily consumable goods such as Oil, Biscuits, and Milk, indicating a strong demand for essential items. The top-selling non-consumable goods are Earphones and Power Bank, suggesting a growing need for personal electronics. Overall, the data suggests a balanced product mix with a focus on both essential and discretionary items.
detections.recommendation: To optimize inventory management and reduce waste, we recommend implementing a just-in-time (JIT) inventory replenishment strategy for top-selling consumable goods like Oil, Biscuits, and Milk. Additionally, we suggest conducting market research to identify emerging trends in personal electronics and adjust our product offerings accordingly to capitalize on growing demand for items like Earphones and Power Bank.
